messages.author: 96ac8657240877c2
messages.subject: ezplot broken?
parts:
Hi Mike,

I was working yesterday and after restarting R, I noticed that all my
ezplot came with the same error:

Error in ezANOVA_main(data = data, dv = dv, wid = wid, within =
within, :
"dv" is not a variable in the data frame provided.

They surely were working before and even the example in the ezPlot
help file produces the same error. I tried the dev version as well as
the repository version with no success, could you give me some hints
on how to fix it?

thanks,

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] ezplot broken?
parts:
Darn, that's a bug caused by my recent
(https://github.com/mike-lawrence/ez/commit/4d135d2f4b12b667f0e9537b314fcfa3f72b734b)
attempt to permit a lazy-typist method of specifying some arguments
across ez. Working on the fix now, which should be up within the
hour...
